justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-agent/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/VirtualMachine.java` (AbstractBase at lines 197-222, plus `ForHotSpot` and `ForOpenJ9` later in the same file). `AbstractBase` is only a tiny helper with exactly 3 one-line methods (`loadAgent`, `loadAgentPath`, `loadAgentLibrary`) that just delegate to the two-argument overloads; it has no fields, no independent state, and no additional responsibilities. The substantial platform-specific behavior is implemented in the concrete subclasses, so this class does not show insufficient modularization.
